[[Warbringer]] is a [[legendary back item]] obtainable through [[World versus World]]. Earning this item also unlocks a unique [[Warbringer (glider)|glider skin]]. Does not require any [[expansion]] to obtain.

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|Warbringer is made from the salvaged remnants of enemies fallen, emblazoned with swords and spears pulled from still-warm corpses. It is a reminder of battles won and lost—whispers of victory.}}

== Notes ==
* Upon un-sheathing weapons, the two turret-like parts extend, causing the backpack to burn more intensely briefly. Additionally, when weapons are drawn, jumping causes the effect to happen again.
* A total of 2800 {{item icon|WvW Skirmish Claim Ticket}}s are required. At the maximum rate of [[Skirmish reward track|365]]+[[Weekly World vs. World|90]]=455 {{item icon|WvW Skirmish Claim Ticket}}s per week this will take a minimum of 7 weeks to obtain.
* Released with the Competitive Feature Pack on June 6th, 2017.
